video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/8, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Stormtrack continues to favor PNW/BC through 11/14.  Drier break tonight-Monday then next storm system arrives Tuesday along with a moderate intensity atmospheric river contribution.  The pattern eventually breaks south and hits the Sierra, UT, CO, AZ, NM on/after 11/16-11/19.
